finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 into [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** Of 380 commits, 14 matter.

Three are breaking. Internal error types stopped being re-exported. The v1 export route is gone. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`.

One feature: webhook retries with backoff. Nine real fixes, including request bodies leaking into logs.

Perf work was internal only, so I left it out.

Next: confirm the Node minimum. Six commits say `note the minimum node version` and CI moved to node 22, but no log line names the number.
